prompt:
A static medium shot holds on him, seen from the hips up. The camera is locked on a tripod and stays there for the whole shot: the same lens, the same height, the same distance. Keep his position and his distance from the camera exactly as in the image.

It is moving day and he is in a good mood: polite, cheerful, sure of his Spanish.

He says good morning and asks one short question. He speaks towards a point just beyond the right edge of the picture, level with his own eyes. Let his face follow the voice.

His hand nearer the car stays resting on the box in the open boot, and his other arm stays relaxed, exactly as in the image.

Across his chest we see only his plain white T-shirt, from the first frame to the last.

On the right of the picture, between him and the edge of the frame, the sunny pavement and the ochre facade run on, open and quiet, from the first frame to the last.

Finally he stops speaking and listens without speaking, his mouth closed, friendly, waiting for the answer. He blinks, he breathes, and he holds that expression the whole time he waits.

Behind him the sunny street stays quiet, soft and out of focus. His eyes rest on a fixed point just beyond the right edge of the frame and stay there for the whole shot.

The framing holds to the very end: in the last frame he is the same size and in the same place in the picture as in the first.
